name: @epoch/cross-domain-integration
description: W032 Cross-domain scenario packs: named scenarios that CROSS the two domain packs through the @epoch/test-harness scenario engine — ONE solution carrying BOTH a construction work-package (W026 BOQ/programme projections) and a software work-package (W027 roadmap/backlog projections), sharing the SAME delivery record, actualization fold and variance computation; cross-pack consistency (both packs' projections identity-map the same ProgramOfWork lines/milestones/activities); positive + negative (cross-tenant denial recorded in-trace; authority-bypass attempt rejected) + recovery (tamper detection -> verified-prefix continuation) evidence; trace-replay-deterministic named tests. NOT a pnpm workspace importer: tests/integration sits outside the pnpm-workspace.yaml globs (owned surface, root manifests frozen), so this manifest DECLARES the frozen devDependency policy while import resolution happens via vitest resolve.alias + tsconfig paths. Run via: pnpm --filter @epoch/pack-construction exec vitest run --root ../../tests/integration.
